title: The intersection dual of geodesic currents
summary: Geodesic currents on closed hyperbolic surfaces are measures on the unit tangent bundle invariant under geodesic flow and orientation reversal. Every geodesic current induces a dual function on curves via the geometric intersection pairing. It is natural to ask which curve functions are dual to geodesic currents, that is, which arise as intersection functionals of a geodesic current. In this paper we give a purely axiomatic and combinatorial characterization of curve functionals dual to geodesic currents.
